column1: # techneissa's fork: interface text for fork features, added to craft-i18n's locales/sr-latn/photocraft.tsv at build time (crates/ui-egui/fork_i18n.rs). Rows the official catalog already has are dropped.

column2: Models are optional and run entirely on this computer. Downloading fetches the model file from Hugging Face; no images or documents are ever uploaded. Without a model, Select Subject, Remove Background and Remove Subject use the built-in (non-AI) methods.
column3: Modeli su opcioni i rade u potpunosti na ovom računaru. Preuzimanje dobavlja datoteku modela sa Hugging Face; slike i dokumenti se nikada ne otpremaju. Bez modela, Izaberi subjekat, Ukloni pozadinu i Ukloni subjekat koriste ugrađene metode bez AI.
